spans.text: Fabu zi ye Sigai Renquan Xuanyan, zowei soyou renmin ho soyou guaejia nulie sexian li gongtong biaozun, yi qi mei ye go ren ho sehui jigou jincang minlian ben xuanyan, nulie tonggo jiaohui ho jiaoyue cwjin dui quanli ho ziyou li zunzong, bin tonggo guaejia li ho guaeji li jianjin cosi, si zixi quanli ho ziyou zai go huiyuan guae bensen renmin jie zai qi guanxia xia lintu li renmin zong daedao pubian ho youxiao li cenren ho zunxin;
